dataSource.note: Trim names, MSRPs, features, freight/PDI, fees, and BC offer rates/terms come from the Mits verified data pack (Nov 11, 2026). Weekly payments in the finder are recalculated with one consistent formula and do not copy the guide weeklies (those sometimes deducted employee price adjustments, and they used up to $799 dealer admin instead of Tricity’s $995 documentation fee).

finance.docFeeNote: Tricity default documentation fee. The Mits BC offer all-in figures used up to $799 dealer administration and listed doc_fee as null (no $995 fee in those offer files). This finder uses $995 and does not also add the $799 admin fee. Change docFee here if you want a different amount.
finance.employeeAdjustmentNote: Employee price adjustments exist on some models in the Mits files but are NOT deducted here, so weekly comparisons stay consistent across the lineup.
finance.formula: PMT = P * i / (1 - (1+i)^-n), i = APR/52, n = termMonths * 52 / 12, $0 down, before taxes. P = MSRP + freight/PDI + A/C charge + tire duty + EHF + docFee.
notes: Weekly payments are approximate estimates only, for comparison, and are not an offer to finance.
Each model uses its published Mitsubishi Canada BC finance rate and term (valid November 3–30, 2026).
Principal P = official MSRP + freight & PDI + $100 A/C charge + tire duty + $5.24 EHF + the documentation fee in this config (default $995).
Employee price adjustments are not deducted.
Payments are before taxes. Licensing, insurance, registration and other charges are extra.
On approved credit (OAC). Rates, terms and payments vary by customer, model, trim and current programs, and are subject to change — confirm with the dealer.
The 2027 Eclipse Sportback 3.49% APR includes a 1.5% loyalty rate reduction for qualifying customers; the non-loyalty rate was not confirmed.
Federal EVAP is not included in PHEV or Sportback payments.
Dealer may sell for less. Inventory and official pricing can change.

inventoryNote: Mits research files do not include a current Tricity new-vehicle stock list by trim. tricitymits.com inventory pages were blocked by the dealership site’s bot protection. In-stock flags below are based on AutoTrader listings for Tricity Mitsubishi (dealer id 47941112) on November 11, 2026, which showed new examples of: 2026 Eclipse Cross (31), 2026 Outlander (40), 2026 Outlander PHEV (59), 2026 RVR (13), 2027 Eclipse Sportback EV (3), 2027 Outlander (7), 2027 RVR (21). Set inStock to false on a model in this file to hide it from the finder. Not every official trim is necessarily on the lot at this moment.
